title: Bangladesh votes in landmark election after Gen Z uprising
text: Bangladesh votes in landmark election after Gen Z uprisingBangladeshis lined up outside polling booths as voting began for a pivotal election for the South Asian nation, marking a return to democracy after the 2024 ouster of long-time premier Sheikh Hasina in a Gen Z driven uprising. #bangladesh #election #genzrevolution #democracy #southasia #polls #News #Reuters #Newsfeed Read the story here: https://reut.rs/4tC6Td2 👉 Subscribe: http://smarturl.it/reuterssubscribe Keep up with the latest news from around the world: https://www.reuters.com/ Follow Reuters on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Reuters Follow Reuters on Twitter: https://twitter.com/Reuters Follow Reuters on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/reuters/?hl=en
